shots.subtitle_en: I failed an exam I was sure I would pass, and came home deeply sad.
My mother saw my face: "My child, what's wrong?" When I told her what happened, she told me a story.
Long ago, a king was travelling to a ceremony with his faithful servant.
His horse stepped into a hole and fell. The king was thrown off, hurting his hand and leg.
But the servant calmly said, "Everything is for the good."
Furious, the king threw the servant into a pit and rode on alone.
People seeking someone with no blemish on their body, to offer as a sacrifice, seized the king.
But they saw his wounds and let him go. And the king remembered his servant's words.
The king went back, pulled the servant out and told him everything. The servant said, "Everything is for the good."
"How was throwing you into the pit good?" "If I had gone with you, they would have sacrificed me."
When she finished, my sadness was gone. My result hadn't changed, but my outlook had. Everything is for the good.
